messages:
maya-sales: Heads-up: AuroraHealth POC is blocked. CISO demands BYO-KMS attestation + committed pricing before exec signoff. Need quick triage.
alan-se: Can someone drop the questionnaire link? Ill start draft answers.
maya-sales: Uploaded to drive: https://drive.local/aurora/sec-q.pdf. Main asks: BYO-KMS, audit retention, regional egress, 99.9% p99.
emma-eng: Their test load is ~1.2k concurrent streams, avg seq 400. We'll need Dedicated + pinned model to hit p99.
ryan-ops: Ops needs peering details and customer IAM thumbprint for BYO-KMS. We also want a feature flag for KMS failover.
natasha-ciso: We need HSM attestation and clear separation of keys from control plane. Legal + infra artifacts required.
liz-legal: I can draft an attestation addendum once infra provides a short tech note and diagram.
trevor-fin: Finance can propose committed tiers: 18-22% baseline discount for 12mo commit, extra rebate for sustained >1k qps. I'll send a draft.
bridge-bot: Exec-bridge scheduled: #exec-aurora-bridge 2026-05-20 16:00 UTC.
emma-eng: Will upload a minimal network diagram and a sample config snippet today.
ryan-ops: I'll add a runbook for BYO-KMS failover and metrics (kms.failover_count). ETA tomorrow AM.
alan-se: Draft security answers + fallback wording by EOD. No promises on auto-fallback without feature flag.
natasha-ciso: For audit retention up to 7 years we can forward logs to customer storage; note cost implications.
liz-legal: Draft addendum in drive; need exact wording on "no vendor key access" vs emergency process. Suggest: no routine access; documented emergency process with customer approval.
maya-sales: Great. Action list: 1) Alan: sec answers. 2) Emma: infra diagram. 3) Ryan: runbook + flag. 4) Liz: attestation draft. 5) Trevor: pricing table. Bring materials to the exec-bridge.
alan-se: Will post links when ready.
ryan-ops: Noted.
bridge-bot: Reminder: exec-bridge prep doc: https://drive.local/aurora/exec-deck.pdf
maya-sales: Thanks all  Ill consolidate for the bridge.
